theorem TrotterError.commutatorExpansion_conj {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸]
    [CompleteSpace 𝔸] {s : ℕ} (A : Fin s → 𝔸) (B : 𝔸) (p : ℕ) (τ : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    multiConj A B τ =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range p, conjCoeff A B j * (τ ^ j : 𝔸)) + commutatorRemainder A B p τ := by sorry
